faq.q: How do I reach customer service?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com. That is the way to reach us, and you keep a written record of the question and the answer.

faq.q: Can you help before I choose a plan?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us what you sell and where you advertise. We can point you to a starting place such as [AI image to video](page:image-to-video). Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300. Premium is $63 for 600.
We reply by email after a person has read your note. There is no promised hour. A clear note lets us find the job on the first read.

faq.q: What details help support find my photo or video?
faq.a: The email on your account, what happened, roughly when it happened, and a screenshot of any error. That is enough to look it up.

faq.q: What if a failed photo or video did not return credits?
faq.a: A failed photo or video returns its credits on its own. If you do not see them, email support with the time you made it and we will check.

faq.q: Is email the only support channel?
faq.a: Yes. Email support@aivideosugc.com from the address on your account. We do not offer phone support or live chat.

faq.q: Can support help me publish to TikTok or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. If a send to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook did not go through, email the account address, what you tried, and about when it happened.

faq.q: Who do I email about an actor, captions, or my own software?
faq.a: Write to support@aivideosugc.com from the account email, and say what you were trying to do. That might be a saved presenter, captions, or a software connection.
